key_concepts.formula: Cost Price (C.P.): Purchase price + overheads. Selling Price (S.P.): Price at which item is sold.
Profit = S.P. − C.P. | Loss = C.P. − S.P. | Profit% = (Profit / C.P.) × 100 | Loss% = (Loss / C.P.) × 100.
When two items are sold at x% gain and x% loss respectively, overall transaction results in a loss of x²/100 %.
